preview.text: Austria Women play Sweden Women in a T20 match at Moara Vlasiei Cricket Ground, Bucharest, where the usual first-innings score in the 30 recorded T20 matches is 110. Sweden Women won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to an 88 per cent chance of rain and about 9 degrees.

summary.text: AUTW scored 91-9 with Andrea Mae Zepeda making 38 off 33 balls, while Hariharan Shreya took 2 for 12. SWEW replied with 20-1 as Anya Vaidya scored 7 off 13 balls and M Pathirannehelage claimed 1 for 6, resulting in a 9-wkts win for Sweden Women.
